title: Deterministic Grid Layouts for CSS-Based Graph Rendering in Ruby: Complexity, Invariants, and Empirical Performance
topic: Creating Diagrams and Graphs Using Modern CSS
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: This paper investigates a Ruby library that constructs directed graphs and renders them as CSS-based diagrams. The core contribution is a deterministic grid layout algorithm that assigns each node a unique (row, column) pair using the formula $C=\lceil\sqrt{n}\rceil$ and $\text{Stratum}-\text{Analytics}=\lceil n/C\rceil$. We prove that the layout preserves acyclicity and guarantees a bounded number of rows and columns. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 7763 system shows a mean latency of 108 211.74 \textmu{}s and a throughput of 9 241 ops/s over 30 iterations. The implementation is fully open-source and available at \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/ruby-algorithms-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261112_130243_creating_diagrams_and_graphs_u}.
